job.title: Senior Interior Designer
job.description:
You'll be part of a small, close knit team where architecture and interiors sit side by side, taking homes from the very first client conversation through to the final install.

What you'll do:

  • Lead interior design on high end residential projects, with a strong focus on townhouse and brownstone renovations
  • Take projects through every phase from schematic design and design development to construction documents and CA
  • Produce and coordinate detailed drawing sets in AutoCAD including plans, RCPs, elevations, millwork and finish details
  • Select and specify materials, finishes, fixtures, lighting and FF&E, and present confidently to clients
  • Work closely with the project architects, contractors and fabricators to protect design intent on site
  • Guide and support junior members of the team

What you'll bring:

  • 10+ years in interior design ideally within an architecture practice or high end residential studio
  • A degree in interior design, architecture or a related field
  • High end residential experience, ideally townhouse, brownstone or prewar renovations
  • Expert AutoCAD and Photoshop proficiency
  • A deep knowledge of millwork, materials and detailing, especially in older buildings
  • Familiarity with NYC renovation, DOB and Landmarks processes is a real plus

The package:

  • $120,000 - $130,000 pa DOE
  • 401K
  • Healthcare
  • 15 days PTO PLUS the week between Christmas and New Years off!

About the studio:

They're best known for thoughtful renovations of historic townhouses and brownstones across New York. The work is warm, crafted and quietly modern while respecting each projects original character. You'll be shaping beautiful homes in some of New York's best loved neighbourhoods, alongside a team that truly values craft and collaboration.

Interested?
Send your resume and a PDF portfolio (under 10MB).
No sponsorship available. You must have the right to work in the US and be within commuting distance of Brooklyn.

job.title: Interior Design Project Manager
job.description:
Interior Design Project Manager | Luxury Hospitality, Residential & Retail | Globally Renowned Design Studio, NYC

If you've spent the last few years steering high end interiors projects from concept all the way through to site, and you want to run the kind of work that ends up on the covers of the world's best design magazines, this opportunity might well be for you.

A globally celebrated interior design studio is growing its New York team. They need a Project Manager who can protect design intent while keeping schedules, fees and budgets firmly on track. Experience managing interiors projects through every phase, construction administration included, is a must.

You'll be the operational backbone of each project, working hand in hand with Design Directors, Project Leads and in house specialist teams, plus clients, operators, consultants and contractors around the world.

What you'll do

  • Build and manage project schedules, milestones and workplans alongside the Design Directors and Project Leads
  • Own project financials including fee schedules, billing projections, forecasting and preliminary FF&E budgets
  • Lead client, consultant and vendor coordination through documentation and delivery, driving value engineering without losing the design
  • Run QA/QC reviews at key milestones and flag constructability risks early
  • Manage CA including shop drawings, samples, RFIs, submittals, change orders and additional services via platforms such as Procore
  • Lead site visits, mock up reviews and factory visits (some international), issuing site reports and punch lists
  • Mentor junior team members and help shape staffing and resourcing

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years in project management within interior design or architecture
  • A bachelor's degree in interior design, architecture, project management or a related field
  • Demonstrable luxury hospitality, residential or retail interiors experience
  • Projects managed through every phase from concept to construction administration, with built work to show for it
  • A confident grasp of fee structures, billable hours, budgets and revenue forecasting
  • Strong MS Project and Excel skills, plus experience with project and financial tracking platforms
  • AutoCAD, Revit and Procore experience is a real plus
  • Hands on experience with pricing, procurement and contract administration
  • Highly organized, proactive and calm under pressure, with a passport ready for international travel

The package

  • $100,000 - 140,000 pa base
  • Competitive benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and professional development
  • Exposure to high profile projects across hospitality, residential, retail and commercial
  • A flexible end to the working week

About the studio

This internationally acclaimed studio has spent decades shaping some of the world's most talked about hotels, residences and retail flagships.

With studios in North America and projects across the globe, they're known for immersive, beautifully crafted interiors and an obsessive eye for detail. The culture is creative and collaborative, with real investment in learning, sustainability and inclusion.

You'll keep world class projects running beautifully alongside some of the most respected creative minds in interior design.

Interested?

Apply with your most up to date Resume and a PDF portfolio or project list showing your role, phases and project values (under 10MB) by pressing the apply button to be considered.

We receive many applications so if you do not hear from us within 5 days, please consider your application unsuccessful this time. We will keep a copy of your details on file for future vacancies.

No sponsorship is available. Applicants must have the right to work in the US and be based in (or within easy commuting distance of) Manhattan.

job.title: Senior Interior Designer
job.description:
Senior Interior Designer | Workplace & Commercial Interiors | San Francisco

If you've spent the last decade leading workplace and commercial interiors from the first visioning session through to move in day, and you want real ownership of your projects (and a real stake in the firm), this opportunity might well be for you.

A respected, award winning architecture and interiors practice in San Francisco is hiring a Senior Interior Designer to lead its workplace projects. You'll need 12+ years in workplace, commercial interiors and tenant improvement work, with built projects to show for it.

You'll act as lead designer on several complex projects at once, run small to mid size teams and work side by side with the Principals, Architects and Project Managers. Clients will see you in the room from the first pitch and real estate tour right through to post occupancy.

What you'll do

  • Lead design on multiple workplace and commercial interiors projects, from test fits and concept through CDs, CA and post occupancy studies
  • Run client meetings including pitches, visioning, programming, workplace strategy and detailed design presentations
  • Manage small to mid size project teams and mentor junior designers in the studio and on site
  • Work directly with clients, furniture dealers, fabricators, consultants, contractors and building agencies
  • Keep a close eye on cost estimates and design budgets
  • Support new business through proposals, interviews and PR

What you'll bring

  • 12+ years in interior design or architecture, with a primary focus on workplace, commercial interiors and tenant improvement
  • A bachelor's degree or higher in interior design or architecture
  • Proven experience as lead designer across every phase, with built workplace projects in your portfolio
  • Deep knowledge of workplace strategy, design research and FF&E, plus a clear grasp of corporate real estate goals
  • Strong working knowledge of California building, fire and accessibility codes for interiors
  • Expert Revit skills, plus Adobe Creative Suite and Mural
  • Enscape, hand sketching and Citrix experience are a real plus
  • Hands on LEED or WELL project experience, with NCIDQ or CCIDC certification and LEED or WELL accreditation strongly preferred
  • A generous, collaborative leader who enjoys mentoring and thrives at pace

The package

  • $115,000 to $145,000 base, depending on experience
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
  • 401(k) plus pre tax FSAs for medical, childcare and commuting
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • Employee stock ownership after your first year
  • Hybrid working, with regular in person time at the studio, with clients and on site

About the studio

This employee owned practice has spent decades building a reputation for thoughtful, people centered design. With studios in several major US cities, they work across commercial, institutional, education and residential sectors, with workplace at the heart of what they do. Wellness, sustainability and equity shape every project, as does a real passion for bringing existing buildings back to life. Egos stay at the door. The work is collaborative and led by the client's vision.

You'll lead meaningful workplace projects with a close knit team that puts real value on mentoring, continuous learning and work life balance.

Interested?

Apply with your most up to date resume and a PDF portfolio or work samples (under 10MB). 

No sponsorship is available. Applicants must have the right to work in the US and be based in (or within easy commuting distance of) San Francisco.

  • Proven ownership of project fees, budgets and profitability
  • Working knowledge of California building, fire and accessibility codes for interior environments

job.title: Senior Architect III - Healthcare
job.description:
An established, multidisciplinary design practice with a strong healthcare portfolio including hospitals, ambulatory care and specialty clinical environments, is looking for a Senior Architect III to lead complex projects and cross-office teams from concept through construction close-out.

One position but three possible bases; Boise, Denver or Sacramento.

Role Responsibilities include:
  • Design and technical delivery on complex healthcare projects, owning scope, schedule, budget, and QA/QC from concept through construction administration
  • Multidisciplinary coordination and clinical stakeholder engagement, including Infection Control Risk Assessments (ICRA)
  • Client relationships, team mentorship, and contributions to proposals and business development

Role Requirements:
  • Licensed Architect, 10+ years leading complex projects, fluent in FGI Guidelines, CMS, Joint Commission, and NFPA 99/101
  • Proven healthcare project experience (hospitals, ambulatory care, or specialty clinical work) and multidisciplinary team leadership
  • Proficiency in Revit and/or AutoCAD
  • Nice to have: ACHA certification, healthcare master planning/BD experience,
  • LEED/BIM/IPD knowledge, Bluebeam and Adobe suite

Salary is dependent on experience with a range of $160,000 - $200,000 pa. Shortlisted candidates will receive a full job description, details of the firm and full rundown of benefits, bonuses and career development opportunities.

Benefits include (but are not limited to):
  • Hybrid working (with possibility for remote working)
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • 401K matched
  • Healthcare

Shortlisted candidates will be those that match the necessary qualifications and experience listed and who are authorized to work in the US - no sponsorship available at this time.

job.title: Senior Interior Designer & Project Manager
job.description:
An acclaimed, design-driven residential studio on Manhattan's Upper East Side is seeking a Senior Designer to join its close-knit team.

This is a brilliant opportunity to be hands on in designing and delivering refined residential interiors across New York - the studios projects regularly appear in the pages of Architectural Digest, Vogue, Elle Decor, Town & Country, House Beautiful and more.

Listed in the AD100, the studio is known for interiors that strike a confident balance between timeless and contemporary aesthetics.

This is an outstanding platform for a technically strong, detail-obsessed Senior Designer who wants Principal-level exposure, true ownership of high-profile projects, and a portfolio built upon some of the best addresses on the East Coast.

You'll partner directly with the Principals across the full arc of a project, from first concept through the final install. You'll also lead multiple high-end residential engagements simultaneously while providing steady oversight to keep design intent, budget, and schedule all moving in the right direction.

Responsibilities include:
  • Partner with Principals from programming through construction administration, leading multiple luxury residential projects with full ownership of quality, budgets, and timelines
  • Coordinate architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, and artisans to ensure seamless execution from design through completion
  • Source, specify, and procure furniture, antiques, lighting, textiles, and finishes - developing FF&E plans, specs, and full procurement documentation aligned with vision and budget
  • Oversee custom fabrication and decorative procurement end-to-end, from pricing through delivery, installation and closeout
  • Lead on-site installation coordination and prepare client and Principal-facing presentations, keeping all documentation, schedules, and budgets accurate and current

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Interior Design
  • 7–10 years of professional interior design experience, including 5+ years in high-end residential design at the Senior Designer / Project Manager level
  • Strong command of NYC's luxury furnishings and trade resources
  • Track record managing luxury residential construction (new build and renovation) with regular, hands-on site presence
  • Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD, Adobe CS, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office
  • Familiarity with Design Manager
  • Strong graphic presentation and hand-sketching skills - Rhino or Revit rendering ability is a bonus
  • Exceptional organizational, project management, and written/verbal communication skills
  • A discreet, and reliable presence - comfortable representing the studio directly with high-net-worth clients
  • Valid driver's license, with flexibility to travel to project sites
  • So why apply for this role with this studio?You'll have direct, regular collaboration with the Principals with exposure to product design and brand collaboration. Joining a friendly, quality driven studio, you'll be among talented and experienced peers while gaining exposure to a portfolio of architecturally significant, editorially celebrated residences.

Salary range for this role is based on the experience you'll bring to the team but will be within the range of $110,000 - $150,000 pa.

Applicants must have the Right To Work in the States without any sponsorship requirement.

Interested? Apply now with your latest resume and portfolio (less than 5mb) to ngregory@planningrecruitment.com

job.title: BIM Coordinator
job.description:
The BIM Coordinator plays a vital role in enhancing project delivery processes within my client’s architectural practice.

This position extends beyond model coordination, focusing on improving workflows, maintaining information consistency, and supporting teams in delivering high-quality, model-based outputs efficiently.

Working closely with project teams and senior leadership, the BIM Coordinator will help embed best practices across ArchiCAD-based workflows while contributing to the continued development of the practice’s digital strategy.

Key Competencies, Skills & Requirements

  • Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technology, or a related discipline (MA in Architecture or equivalent preferred).
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a BIM Coordinator within the UK commercial sector, ideally gained within a medium to large architectural practice.
  • Strong understanding of current BIM workflows, processes, and industry requirements.
  • Proven experience using ArchiCAD within an architectural environment.
  • Sound knowledge of the UK BIM Framework, including ISO 19650 and associated standards.
  • Understanding of the Information Management Mandate and UK BIM Framework.
  • Experience with ArchiCAD is essential; familiarity with Solibri, Rhino, Grasshopper, and Revit interoperability is advantageous.
  • Strong practical experience in clash detection and issue management.
  • Knowledge of UK Building Regulations and project specification management is desirable.
  • Good understanding of file exchange procedures, uploads/downloads, and management within a Common Data Environment (CDE).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.
  • Collaborative, approachable, and enthusiastic team player.
  • Passion for continuous learning and keeping up to date with BIM developments and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to understand and map design workflows across all RIBA stages.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on identifying root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Interest in automation and scripting tools such as Grasshopper and Python.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • BIM Management & Support
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all ArchiCAD, CAD, and BIM-related queries within the practice.
  • Support project teams in developing and implementing modelling strategies aligned with project-specific BIM requirements.
  • Assist in managing and maintaining ArchiCAD software, templates, protocols, and libraries across the practice.
  • Help ensure project compliance with BIM standards, industry requirements, and collaborative workflows involving consultants, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Provide day-to-day troubleshooting and technical support for ArchiCAD-related issues.
  • Support the BIM Manager in maintaining practice-wide BIM manuals and project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BEPs).
  • Project Responsibilities
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and propose practical improvements.
  • Support structured information management across all project stages.
  • Reduce duplication and rework through improved model and data coordination.
  • Assist Project Leads and Design Teams in establishing project goals, workflows, and BIM implementation strategies to meet contractual obligations.
  • Maintain project BIM documentation including BEPs, TIDPs, BRMs, and related records.
  • Implement digital standards consistently across assigned projects.
  • Liaise with client BIM advisors and external design team BIM Coordinators to manage coordinated BIM models and project documentation.
  • Perform quality assurance checks on BIM models.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent library of ArchiCAD objects and components.
  • Promote modelling best practices to support 3D, 4D, and 5D project delivery.
  • Deliver BIM-related training and technical support to project teams.
  • Training & Development
  • Conduct ArchiCAD inductions for new team members and support ongoing staff training initiatives.
  • Stay informed of BIM regulations, standards, and industry developments, sharing relevant updates with project teams.
  • Assist in preparing reports and documentation relating to BIM coordination, compliance, and project delivery requirements.
  • Collaboration & Coordination
  • Work closely with Job Runners and project teams to define BIM deliverables and improve interdisciplinary collaboration.
  • Assist with federated model coordination and clash detection using software such as Solibri.
  • Participate in BIM and CAD coordination meetings and contribute to the development of standardised workflows across the practice.
  • Liaise with the IT team regarding software updates, licensing, and server management associated with BIM processes.
  • Quality Assurance & Standards
  • Ensure ArchiCAD models are maintained in accordance with agreed modelling standards and quality procedures.
  • Assist in updating and refining ArchiCAD templates and libraries to improve workflow efficiency.
  • Support the BIM Manager in reviewing project workflows and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Provide guidance on visual outputs and presentation standards, including model-based drawings and 3D visualisations.

Workflow & Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies within project workflows and recommend effective improvements.
  • Support structured information flow throughout all RIBA stages.
  • Minimise duplication and rework through enhanced model and data management practices.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of practice-wide digital standards, workflows, and BIM processes.

About My Client

My client is a highly respected architectural practice specialising in traditional and progressive classical architecture alongside contextual urbanism. Led by an experienced executive team and design directors with distinct design approaches, the practice delivers a diverse portfolio of work across the UK and internationally.

Projects include new-build town and country houses, renovations, extensions, heritage and listed buildings, as well as commercial, healthcare, office, residential, and large-scale masterplanning developments. The practice is recognised for combining traditional architectural principles with innovative and collaborative project delivery methods.

Location: New York City | Full-Time | Hybrid Eligible

Our client is a forward-thinking design practice driven by sustainability, innovation, and meaningful community impact. Their work goes beyond buildings — they create environments that strengthen neighborhoods and elevate the built landscape.

They have a diverse portfolio spanning residential, institutional, and large-scale campus developments, every project is grounded in decarbonization strategies, adaptive reuse, and thoughtful urban integration.

With more than $250 million in active construction across multiple complex projects, they are entering an exciting phase of growth.

Seeking an accomplished leader with 10+ years of experience — ideally with deep expertise in renovation and rehabilitation of existing structures — to oversee sophisticated, multi-building initiatives. This includes two major campuses currently under construction.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage all project phases for a range of building types and scales — from interior renovations to large campus overhauls with sustainability upgrades.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for clients, consultants, and construction teams, in collaboration with firm leadership.
  • Oversee design intent throughout the life of the project, including any revisions, addenda, and amendments.
  • Lead construction administration tasks, including reviewing submittals, RFIs, site visits, and responding to existing condition discoveries.
  • Direct and mentor project teams throughout construction, ensuring quality, coordination, and compliance.

Required Skills & Experience:
  • Strong background in building rehabilitation, adaptive reuse, and renovation — including exteriors, interiors, and full site updates.
  • Multi-family residential experience preferred.
  • Proven experience in construction documentation and administration.
  • Strong communication, organization, and leadership skills.
  • 5+ years working in Revit required.
  • Knowledge of NYC building codes and zoning regulations preferred.
  • Experience with NYC public agencies (e.g., NYCHA, HPD) a plus.
  • Familiarity with historic preservation and work involving the Landmarks Preservation Commission is beneficial.
  • Passion for sustainable and resilient design practices; LEED or Passive House credentials a plus.
  • Professional degree in Architecture from an accredited institution required.
  • U.S. architectural license preferred.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

What They Offer:
  • Full benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Paid time off, holidays, and annual bonus

job.title: Intermediate Interior Designer
job.description:
Interior Designer II / Interior Architect II - New York

Our clients interiors practice is driven by a collaborative, conversation-led design ethos—balancing architectural rigor, craftsmanship, and creativity to produce spaces that are timeless, contextual, and compelling.

Who You Are
You’re a designer who cares deeply about creating meaningful places. Visionary but detail-oriented, collaborative yet self-directed, you push ideas forward with clarity, curiosity, and respect. You communicate well, welcome feedback, and bring both authenticity and generosity to the studio.

The Role
As an Interior Designer II / Interior Architect II, you’ll help shape design concepts and carry them through documentation and early construction coordination. You’ll contribute to multiple projects at once, producing interiors that are both conceptually strong and technically sound. You’re comfortable working across all project phases and can generate coordinated construction documents with limited oversight.

What You’ll Do
Design & Planning
  • Support design from concept through documentation

  • Build FF&E packages, coordinate with vendors, and refine designs based on feedback
Project Coordination
  • Assist with client and internal meeting materials
  • Help develop work plans and track progress against schedule and budget
  • Coordinate with consultants and integrate BIM deliverables
  • Support responses to RFIs, submittals, and contractor questions

Documentation
  • Produce DD and CD sets with moderate-to-minimal oversight
  • Develop finish and fixture schedules
  • Review consultant drawings for alignment and accuracy
  • Contribute to specs and maintain document consistency

  • Proficient in Revit, Rhino, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, Enscape, Procore, Bluebeam, and MS Office
  • Strong design, communication, and organizational abilities

Our client is an award winning New York based practice situated in the heart of Manhattan. They foster a collaborative, design-driven workplace built on openness, shared ideas, and a commitment to community. As a practice based around it's people you can expect weekly studio lunches, design presentations, offsite explorations, and in-house arts programming. job.title: Senior Project Architect
job.description:
Senior Project Architect - New York - $75-$100,000 annually

This role is both design-driven and production-focused, with increasing responsibility for technical execution, consultant coordination, and ownership of significant project components under the guidance of the Project Lead and Project Director.

This position is intended for designers and architects with 5+ years of professional experience who demonstrate strong design thinking, growing technical expertise, and the ability to independently lead defined portions of a project while contributing to the overall design vision.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities
  • Design Thinking & Design Development
  • Develop 3D models, diagrams, renderings, and plan studies to advance design intent through iterative project phases
  • Lead design development for assigned areas with a proactive, self-directed approach under Project Lead guidance
  • Contribute to design and presentation materials for internal reviews, client presentations, competitions, and design documentation
  • Produce comprehensive drawing sets from concept design through construction documents for assigned project scope
  • Manage time and workload effectively to meet deadlines while maintaining quality and organization

Technical Understanding & Coordination
  • Develop familiarity with applicable building codes, zoning regulations, and detailing requirements
  • Translate technical requirements into clear, coordinated drawings and diagrams
  • Prepare coordination drawings, markups, and diagrams for consultant meetings
  • Actively collaborate with consultants to resolve coordination issues related to assigned project areas

Qualifications
  • Minimum 5+ years of post-graduate professional experience from Concept Design through Construction
  • Master of Architecture from a NAAB-accredited institution
  • Architectural licensure completed or in progress; AXP and exams underway or completed preferred
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to complex architectural projects across multiple phases
  • Strong design sensibility supported by solid technical and production skills
  • Curious, creative mindset with a willingness to learn and share knowledge with less experienced team members
  • Proficiency in Revit, Rhino, and related digital design workflows
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams
  • Strong organizational, communication, and coordination skills
  • Ability to work full-time, in person, in New York, NY
  • Fluency in English

What’s on Offer
  • Collaboration within a global network of design professionals
  • A dynamic, inclusive workplace that supports creativity, collaboration, and professional growth
  • Generous paid time off

About the Studio
This international architecture and design studio is rooted in strong design values and a collaborative, non-hierarchical culture. The practice emphasizes innovation, shared learning, and a supportive working environment that encourages experimentation and the development of new ideas. The studio operates globally with a diverse, multidisciplinary team.

Shape the Future of Digital Design in Architecture

This is a fantastic opportunity to take the lead on BIM implementation across a range of exciting architectural projects — while helping to shape and elevate the studio’s digital delivery standards.

job.title: BIM Coordinator
job.description:
Specializing in sectors such as aviation, education, rail, hospitality, healthcare, leisure, and retail, my client operates internationally with offices in the UK, Ireland, and the UAE. This role is a fantastic opportunity for a BIM expert to support architectural project teams in utilizing BIM tools and workflows, particularly Autodesk Revit.

Job Summary:
The BIM Coordinator will provide technical support directly to project team members, liaise with the Senior BIM Coordinator, and ultimately report to the Technical Director (BIM). The successful candidate will be responsible for understanding the team's needs for training, workflows, or content and will come from an architectural background with strong communication skills and competencies in the following areas:

Key Responsibilities:
Management:
  • Possess a working knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.
  • Understand and address the information needs of clients.
  • Assist in the creation and management of a BIM Execution Plan (BEP).
  • Help establish the project team's Responsibility Matrix (MPDT).
  • Support the population of a Task Information Delivery Plan (TIDP).
  • Develop and enforce a BIM modeling standard.
  • Administer and manage a Common Data Environment (CDE).
  • Ensure compliance with project standards and protocols.
  • Chair BIM project and team meetings, providing support and training to in-house project teams.
  • Maintain and deliver project BIM models, ensuring adherence to BIM standards, validation, and quality assurance processes.
  • Experience with medium to large-scale complex projects within an architectural office is essential.
  • Advanced understanding of volume strategies, clash avoidance strategies, issue management, and MEP & Structural coordination management is highly beneficial.

Production:
  • Setup and manage in-house project models and models for the supply chain.
  • Produce 3D model elements and manage model outputs.
  • Assist in the preparation and management of COBie information and deliverables.

Software Expertise:
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with Revit and related plugins are essential.
  • Knowledge of visual scripting interfaces such as Dynamo is highly beneficial.
  • Proficiency in Navisworks, including running clash detection and producing clash reports, is highly beneficial.
  • Experience with BIM360-based projects (Docs and Design) is highly beneficial.
  • Knowledge of Solibri for data and geometry checks, producing reports, and creating rules is beneficial.
  • Experience with point cloud software such as ReCap Pro is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with Bentley MicroStation and AECOsim is beneficial.
  • Experience with issue-tracking software such as Revizto, BIMCollab, and/or BIM Track is beneficial.
  • Knowledge of other software such as Rhino, Enscape, and NBS Chorus is beneficial.
  • Coding experience is considered an advantage.

What We Offer:
  • A hybrid working policy, with a requirement to attend the office a minimum of 2 days per week.
  • A competitive salary and benefits package, including a pension scheme and life assurance.
  • Access to private healthcare and an employee assistance program.
  • Opportunities for personalized learning support and career development.
  • A technology-supported agile working environment.
  • Team-building activities and social events.

Join my client's innovative and dynamic team and play a crucial role in shaping sustainable and functional architectural solutions across a variety of sectors.

job.title: Architect

  • Develop technical details and oversee construction documentation with precision and accuracy.

  • Utilise Revit to produce high-standard technical drawings and coordinate with construction teams.

  • ARB-registered Architect (or international equivalent) with a minimum of 2 years+ of post-qualified experience.
  • Strong technical detailing skills, with proven experience in residential project delivery at construction stages.
  • Proficiency in Revit is essential, with a solid understanding of BIM processes.
  • Previous experience on large-scale residential schemes is highly desirable.

Benefits:

job.title: Intermediate Architect
job.description:
Our clients are passionate in their approach and believe great buildings come from dialogue, curiosity, and a balance of creativity and technical rigor.

Who You Are
You’re an architect who sees every project as a chance to shape meaningful places. With 5+ years of Architecture and Planning experience. Visionary yet precise, collaborative yet self-directed, you pair strong design instincts with technical depth. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and elevate work through leadership, mentorship, and thoughtful engagement with clients, consultants, and colleagues.

The Role
As an Architectural Designer II / Architect II, you’ll help drive design development, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to projects from concept through construction. You’ll apply advanced architectural concepts, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and support the development of details, documents, and presentations with increasing independence. You may also guide junior staff.

What You’ll Do
Design & Planning
  • Contribute to design from early concept through detailed documentation
  • Create presentations, renderings, 3D views, and material selections
  • Translate leadership direction into clear design output
  • Understand scope, schedules, and deliverables

Project Coordination
  • Assist with meeting agendas, invites, and minutes
  • Work closely with consultants and manage BIM coordination
  • Support contractor communication, RFIs, and submittals
  • Provide mentorship to less experienced team members

Documentation
  • Produce DD and CD drawings, schedules, and specifications
  • Integrate design changes and coordinate consultant sets
  • Develop and refine project details
  • Organize correspondence and support client meeting prep

Quality & Technical Excellence
  • Follow studio standards and checklists
  • Apply working knowledge of codes and accessibility requirements
  • Maintain clean digital organization and self-check work

Construction Administration
  • Support site visits, shop-drawing review, RFIs, and punch lists
  • Attend progress meetings as directed
  • Help maintain CA logs and prepare record documents

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Architecture or related field
  • 6+ years of professional experience with a strong portfolio
  • Proficiency in Revit, Rhino, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Suite, Enscape, Procore, Bluebeam, and MS Office
  • Strong design, communication, coordination, and organizational skills

Studio Culture & Benefits
Our client are a award winning practice in the heart of Manhattan. They are a collaborative, community-minded studio with an open, design-focused culture.

Expect weekly team lunches, design presentations, offsite explorations, and an active in-house arts program. Benefits include competitive compensation, paid time off, health insurance, 401(k), professional development support, and assistance with licensure and certifications.
